title: Understanding Impact of Human Feedback via Influence Functions

bias_targets.methodology: Injecting bias into the Anthropic-HH dataset by flipping preference labels to favor longer (verbose) responses, and evaluating the ability of influence functions to detect these biased samples using a validation set of concise responses.

Injecting bias by flipping preference labels to favor responses that flatter or agree with the user (scored via LLM prompts), and evaluating the ability of influence functions to detect these biased samples using a validation set of non-sycophantic responses.
